## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** The three extended policies (rules, baselines, all 13 factor ladders with every tier, assembly order, overwrites) and their governing base policies correspond at equal strength; both prerequisite sentences of this task stand verbatim, state form, in their blocked hubs only; the retired clauses are carried as retired.

Policy-side note (not a KB verdict): the source rule of `batch_ext_undelivered_recovery` speaks of "a completed batch" without the "finalized or not" gloss that `batch_ext_mileage_claim`/`batch_ext_mileage_adjustment` carry, although this task's batch is `finalized`. The KB reproduces the source wording; the clawback window (30 days vs 24 h finality) resolves it identically on both sides.
